mask: Identical historical old7 mask AFTER original PatientZ and FIT-only imputer/scaler; zero both mean/SD and corresponding Gate window DELTA; retain14/7slots, original88-position normalization and matched initialization. No input family removed from Raw waveform.
training: Import byte-unchanged original CompactDelta and M8 trainers. Own masked D1 trained from scratch then frozen for own M8. Same foldseed42+1009*fold, FP32/TF32off, optimizer/loss/classweights/dropout/updates/min6/max30/patience6, validation epoch/tau rules. No posthoc threshold/grid change.
reuse_gate: All checkpoints/banks/validation files and historical freeze/seal hashes verified; original independent160-model validation replay PASS. Reuse original M8 Outer logit and embedded base_logit for D1 with its OWN D1 threshold, never M8 threshold. No retraining/re-inference of reused cells.
selection_data: ONLY each original fold FIT and its original validation; never own Outer labels/scores. All configurations are fixed hypotheses. Common-subset nomination from repeated original validation is selection-conditioned exploratory, not an independent evaluation or a new nested-CV performance claim.

selection.tie_order: fewest retained groups, higher validation patient-appearance MacroF1, higher AP, higher AUROC, lexicographic config
selection.M8_nomination_requires: M8 gate; D1 gate is reported separately to identify Raw-dependent tolerance, not silently required or relaxed.
selection.margins_status: Prospective engineering stability allowances, not clinically established noninferiority margins.
selection.no_eligible: retain000; no forced prune; no Outer rescue

statistics.Outer_unit: 80 equally weighted patients; paired draws across every config/head
statistics.development_unit: 65 validation appearances from47 IDs; resample patient-ID clusters with all repeated appearances; selection-conditioned
statistics.factorial_effect: Deletion main effect averaged over other factors; pair interaction averaged over third factor as difference-of-differences; three-way difference-of-difference-of-differences. Positive means deletion beneficial for high-is-good endpoints, not physiological activation.
statistics.conditional_interactions: Each pair at third factor0 and1 also reported; label context explicitly.
statistics.raw_compensation: (M8_config-M8_000)-(D1_config-D1_000), same patient. Positive high-is-good metric means M8 attenuates deletion damage or amplifies deletion benefit. Retraining/normalization and changed base still confound a pure causal Raw mechanism.
statistics.CIs: 95% paired percentile; complete-case across contrast cells per metric; report denominators.42 primary factorial contrasts=7effects*2heads*3metrics additionally Bonferroni familywise95%.Other contrasts exploratory unadjusted. No threshold or model refit inside bootstrap.
statistics.fold_stability: patient-macro each fold; five-fold mean/sampleSD separate from primary patient mean; deletion-minus-reference sign counts/median/worst; analogous source-label summaries, not independent hospitals.

Outer: Freeze ALL80 model-head-fold cells, thresholds, reuse hashes, candidate decision and sources before any NEW Outer inference. Seal scores before reading full labels. Existing Outer viewed repeatedly: EXPLORATORY_REPEATED_TEST. No post-Outer selection/model/tau/rule changes.
boundary: Only4D/5D candidates are eligible in this experiment. No1-3D training, no globally optimal/clinical-necessity claim. Prior seven single-only results may motivate a future independently frozen study, not select a winner here.
privacy: Public source/hashes/anonymous aggregate tables only. No IDs, raw, per-patient/channel predictions, logs, weights/scalers or private paths in public outputs.
